cases.title: Clicking Add note creates a single note with a textarea
cases.description: Verify that clicking the "Add note" button once appends a new <div> element with class "note" to the document body containing a visible, empty <textarea> with data-testid="note-textarea".

cases.title: Multiple rapid clicks on Add note create separate notes
cases.description: Verify that performing multiple rapid clicks on the "Add note" button successfully creates a separate note for each click, each containing its own textarea.

cases.title: Real-time Markdown rendering
cases.description: Verify that as the user types Markdown into the textarea (data-testid="note-textarea"), the content is dynamically rendered in the main display area (data-testid="note-main") with proper HTML formatting and immediately saved to local storage.

cases.title: Invalid Markdown handling
cases.description: Verify that when the user inputs invalid Markdown (e.g., unmatched **), the application does not crash or throw errors, and instead displays the raw input when the user exits the edit mode by clicking the "Edit" button (data-testid="edit-note-button").

cases.title: Create note and verify initial edit mode and local storage
cases.description: Verify that when the app page loads and the user clicks the "Add note" button (data-testid="add-note-button"), a new note is created in edit mode where the textarea (data-testid="note-textarea") is visible and the main content area (data-testid="note-main") remains hidden, and changes typed into the textarea are automatically saved to local storage.

cases.title: Switch between edit and view modes using the Edit button
cases.description: Verify that users can switch between edit and view modes by clicking the "Edit" button (data-testid="edit-note-button"), where in view mode the main content area becomes visible to display formatted content and the textarea is hidden, and in edit mode this behavior is reversed.

cases.title: Delete note via delete button
cases.description: Verify that clicking the "Delete" button (data-testid="delete-note-button") removes the targeted note from the DOM and removes its corresponding entry from localStorage.

cases.title: Retrieve and Render Saved Notes From LocalStorage on Page Load
cases.description: Verify that when the Notes App webpage loads with saved notes in localStorage, it retrieves them and dynamically creates a div element with the class "note" for each, including a tools div with edit and delete buttons, a main div (data-testid="note-main"), and a textarea (data-testid="note-textarea"). Populated notes should have their content displayed in the main div with the textarea hidden by default, while notes with no content show the textarea and hide the main div.

opinions.feedback: All requirements are well covered by distinct, testable, and non-redundant test cases. No blockers or speculative test cases were found.

All requirements and their corresponding test cases have been reviewed. The cases accurately cover the specified functionality including note creation, mode switching, markdown rendering, deletion, and local storage persistence without any blockers.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-1 describes multiple distinct behaviors: single click note creation and multiple rapid clicks creating separate notes; it includes explicit multiple rapid click conditions (Edge scenario). Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-2 describes multiple distinct behaviors including real-time Markdown rendering, handling invalid Markdown displaying raw input upon exiting edit mode, and local storage updates; it explicitly mentions an invalid Markdown error path (Abnormal/Error scenario). Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-3 describes multiple distinct behaviors including initial creation in edit mode, switching between edit and view modes via the Edit button, visibility toggling of textarea and main content, and automatic saving to local storage. Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-4 describes a single straightforward acceptance criterion for deleting a note via the delete button and removing it from DOM and localStorage. Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-5 describes multiple distinct behaviors including retrieving notes on page load, rendering notes from localStorage with tools, main, and textarea elements, handling empty content vs populated content visibility, and handling empty localStorage.
